turns.text: Hi, my washing machine has stopped draining properly.
I can look at that. Do you have the model number?
Yes, it starts with W-D-nine.
Thanks. I've found it. Your standard cover authorises purchases from an approved retailer. Other channels fall outside its terms.
Understood; I checked how the item was purchased.
Great. Is it plumbed into a standard waste pipe?
Yes, the usual arrangement.
Okay. Is the phone number ending in one-seven-four still the best number to reach you?
Yes, that is mine.
And is it level?
Yes, it sits flat.
So the washing machine was purchased through an approved retailer?
I am not sure; I do not have the original purchase detail available.
Would weekday or weekend suit for a visit?
Weekdays are easier.
Does your washing machine make any unusual noise?
There is a low humming sound.
How long has it been making this noise?
About four days now.
Have you cleaned the filter recently?
Yes, I cleared it yesterday.
Would you like me to confirm the details of your booking by text?
Yes, in writing please.
Is there parking near the property?
Yes, right outside.
I will Close the request and ask the user to call back.
Okay, I will wait to hear the outcome.
I came back after half an hour and nothing seems to have been opened for it.
I will Leave the claim alone and wait another interval.
